fusions.name: Mile-Earned Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a long shot that deals 30 damage, up to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 10 tiles, and ignores armour. Its damage rises 5% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +50%).

fusions.name: Heel Down
fusions.desc: Plants your boot on a target at or below 25% health and fires point-blank, dealing 22 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shorter Road
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 35% further.

fusions.name: Marching Powder
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch on foot, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
